# Noto Serif CJK raster source

- Source: [Noto CJK](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk)
- Release: 2.003
- Regional build inputs: Noto Serif JP, KR, and TC Medium, Subset OTF
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see [OFL.txt](OFL.txt)

The font files are not redistributed with SH3 Enhanced. `tools/render-cjk-fonts.ps1` uses them as local build inputs to generate the Japanese, Korean, and Traditional Chinese glyph coverage in the optional font pack. Keep this notice and the OFL with any distributed raster glyph pack derived from these fonts.
